Gym Connect - React Native + Spring Boot Full-Stack Application

PROJECT OVERVIEW:
- Frontend: React Native (Expo for iOS testing)
- Backend: Spring Boot with SQL
- Auth/Database: Supabase
- Notifications: Firebase Cloud Messaging
- Target: iPhone testing

ARCHITECTURE:
- /mobile: React Native app with Expo, Redux, Firebase setup
- /backend: Spring Boot API, Database models, Supabase integration
- /docs: Configuration guides and API documentation

KEY TECHNOLOGIES:
- React Native with Expo CLI
- Spring Boot 3.x
- PostgreSQL (Supabase)
- Firebase Admin SDK
- Expo Notifications
